name: manual-lending-walkthrough
description: Self-contained walkthrough of the hands-on `lending` subcommand family. Every step routes through a scenario-local state file (`.princeps-walkthrough-state.json` in the current directory) so residue from prior runs or from the default `$HOME/.princeps/lending-state.json` cannot leak in. Pair with `princeps lending list --state-file ./.princeps-walkthrough-state.json` between any two steps to inspect the position state. After the scenario, the file can be safely deleted: `rm -f ./.princeps-walkthrough-state.json`.
headline: Walk the lending sandbox by hand — deposit, borrow, check health, scan — against a clean per-scenario state file.

steps.explanation: Initialize an empty lending state file at a scenario-local path. The Init subcommand overwrites any existing file, so re-running the scenario always starts clean.
Account 1 borrows 200 ETH at the current oracle price of 1 USDC/ETH.
Check account 1's health at the same price — should be HEALTHY.
Now check health at an ETH price of 2 — the debt is worth more in USDC terms.
Scan all accounts for underwater positions at ETH=2.

expected_outcomes.name: one-position-landed
expected_outcomes.description: Exactly one open position after the walkthrough (account 1).

expected_outcomes.name: last-health-healthy
expected_outcomes.description: Even at ETH=2 the cross-margin LT cushion holds — last health step is HEALTHY.

expected_outcomes.name: scan-clean-at-eth-2
expected_outcomes.description: Scan at ETH=2 flags nothing — no liquidatable accounts.
